# routeros_interface_macsec (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) The Ethernet interface MACsec is deployed on. Only one MACsec interface can be created per Ethernet port.
- `name` (String) Name of the MACsec interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `cak` (String, Sensitive) A 16-byte pre-shared Connectivity Association Key, written as a 32 character hex string. RouterOS generates the key automatically when only the Ethernet interface is specified.
- `ckn` (String) A 32-byte Connectivity Association Name, written as a 64 character hex string. RouterOS generates the name automatically when only the Ethernet interface is specified.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `mtu` (Number) Layer3 Maximum Transmission Unit of the MACsec interface.
- `profile` (String) The MACsec profile that determines the key server election parameters.

### Read-Only

- `hw_offloaded` (Boolean) Whether the MACsec encryption of this interface is offloaded to the hardware.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
- `running` (Boolean)
- `status` (String) Current state of the MACsec Key Agreement: disabled, initializing, invalid, negotiating or open-encrypted.
